gates.title: Caching strategy
gates.criteria: Caches justified, bounded, invalidated correctly, isolated between users; no auth, entitlement or financial state cached.
evidence: Sitemap 1 h (public data only)
Seller filter list 10 min (public data, filtering still enforces visibility)
Sales ranking 10 min (ranking only, never prices or stock)
Public images without session or cookies; previews private, no-store
Expired cache entries pruned hourly (PERF-15)
HTML no-cache, private

gates.title: Compression and network transfer
gates.criteria: High-volume responses use an appropriate, verified transfer strategy.
evidence: gzip for CSS/JS/SVG verified (Content-Encoding, Vary)
Sitemap gzip 2.07 MB -> 154 KB
Catalogue HTML 42 KB -> 19 KB
Round trips per page cut by about 3x (PERF-03)
HTML compression off on purpose (BREACH, PERF-22)

gates.title: Images, media and static assets
gates.criteria: Critical pages meet asset budgets without image degradation or accessibility regressions.
evidence: asset-optimization-report.md
CSS 17.9 KB / JS 20.5 KB within budgets
WebP variants at upload, dimensions on every image, no lazy image above the fold
Lab LCP catalogue 592 -> 436 ms

gates.title: Frontend rendering and Web Vitals
gates.criteria: Important journeys meet agreed Web Vitals budgets (field data at the 75th percentile where available).
evidence: evidence/webvitals-after.json: lab LCP 392-448 ms, CLS <= 0.026, TBT <= 64 ms, INP (lab approximation) <= 32 ms on home, catalogue, search, product
gates.reason: Only lab data on one profile exists; no real-user (field) data before launch, and the budgets are provisional. Lab values are not presented as field data.

gates.title: Backend APIs and service integration
gates.criteria: Every critical integration has documented, tested handling for normal operation, rate limiting, timeouts, retries, duplicates and provider failure.
evidence: integration-best-practices.md (vendor docs consulted)
Shkeeper: 10 s / 5 s connect timeouts, no redirects, idempotent invoice creation, webhook HMAC + dedup, polling stop after 3 failures (PERF-14)
Simulation phase 2 and 8 scenarios on the candidate image

gates.title: Third-party package quality and usage
gates.criteria: Important dependencies used per their documentation, without unjustified performance or maintenance risk.
evidence: All direct Composer dependencies up to date (composer outdated --direct)
Deprecated PDO constant avoided on PHP >= 8.4
dompdf only in a queued job
Security gate: advisories (composer, npm, OSV)

gates.title: Memory, CPU, concurrency and resource management
gates.criteria: Within defined resource limits at the target workload; predictable degradation; recovery without leaks.
evidence: evidence/staged-load-after.json: 20 req/s p95 123 ms, 40 req/s p95 550 ms, saturation at 60 req/s, no errors, self-abort works
Recovery after load: 82-107 ms, 68 MB app container, no leftover DB connections
evidence/slow-downloads.json: no FPM worker held by slow clients; download concurrency bounded (PERF-19)
gates.reason: No target workload is defined, the sandbox shares 4 cores with the load generator, and no multi-hour soak test was run. Capacity on production hardware is unknown.

gates.title: Reliability and failure-path efficiency
gates.criteria: Critical workflows fail safely, without retry amplification, preserving consistency.
evidence: PERF-14 polling stop tests
PERF-11 sweeps fixed
Queue: bounded tries with backoff, retry_after 90 s > worker timeout 60 s
Simulation recovery phase (database, queue, mail and Shkeeper outages, disk full) on the candidate image

gates.title: Build, bundle and deployment efficiency
gates.criteria: Artifacts contain only needed components, builds reproducible, size and startup budgets met.
evidence: App image 1.01 GB -> 330 MB (budget 400 MB), web image 93.7 MB (budget 120 MB)
Pinned base images, composer.lock, multi-stage build
Migrations on the full dataset: 2.0 s + 0.8 s + 0.05 s, indexes built concurrently
Health checks on app and db
gates.note: Measured on the sandbox build (Composer from git); the CI job checks the dist-based build against the same budget.

gates.criteria: No high-impact correctness or maintainability defect; mandatory quality checks pass.
evidence: PHPUnit 313/313
PHPStan level 5: 0 (from 392)
Pint, ASCII check

gates.title: Performance regression and benchmark verification
gates.criteria: Required benchmarks complete; agreed budgets satisfied; no unacceptable regression.
evidence: Baseline and candidate measured on identical data and stack (performance-baselines.md)
All provisional budgets met in two runs; run-to-run noise up to 18-25%
gates.reason: The budgets are proposed by this audit and need the owner's approval (release policy: agreed budgets). Measurements on production-like hardware with a separate load generator are also required before the budgets can be called met.
